newsitem.title: USA: Reliability sees Q3 revs/net same/above Q2.
newsitem.headline: Reliability sees Q3 revs/net same/above Q2.

text.p: Reliability Inc said Monday that for the third quarter of 1997, it should have revenues and net income equal to or greater than the second quarter of 1997.

Larry Edwards, president and chief executive officer, issued the forecast as the company reported that higher revenues for the second quarter this year pushed net income to $2.32 million or $0.78 a share, compared to $1.29 million or $0.31 per share for the second quarter of 1996.
The company's forecasts indicates Reliability's total 1997 revenues will increase 15-20 percent and earnings per share should be 60-70 percent above 1996's, he added.
Reliability and its subsidiaries manufacture burn-in and test equipment, loading and unloading equipment and other peripherals for sale to manufacturers and volume users of integrated circuits.
It also makes a line of power sources, including DC-to-DC power converters, and provides conditioning and testing services for integrated circuits in Singapore and Durham, N.C..
